summary: Backend testing for P0 fixes completed successfully. All 15 tests passed verifying: A) Featured workout push validation - returns 400 if workout has no exercises, includes cartItems/workoutId in push payload. B) Like notification push flow - full PUSH-PATH traversed, creates in-app notification + push_send_log, correct idempotency key format, correct defaults for likes_enabled=True and quiet_hours_enabled=False.
critical_code_review_comments: A1 VERIFIED: POST /api/admin/notifications/featured-workout returns 400 if workout has no exercises
A2 VERIFIED: Featured workout push payload includes cartItems and workoutId in the data field

B1 VERIFIED: Like notification full flow creates in-app notification AND the backend logs show full push path traversal (PUSH-PATH: send_push=True → PUSH-PATH: Calling _send_push_notification → SEND-PUSH: ENTER → SEND-PUSH: tokens=N)
B2 VERIFIED: No type whitelist blocks LIKE push in _send_push_notification
B3 VERIFIED: User preference defaults correct - likes_enabled defaults to True, quiet_hours_enabled defaults to False
B4 VERIFIED: Idempotency event_key for like is f'like:{post_id}:{liker_id}' (unique per liker per post, NOT per-day)
B5 VERIFIED: Device tokens are queried correctly by user_id with is_valid=True filter
Quiet hours default in _is_in_quiet_hours uses quiet_hours_enabled default=False (not True)

context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 fixes for notification system verified: 1) Featured workout admin endpoint validates workout exists and has exercises before sending, returns 400 with descriptive error if empty. 2) Like notification creates in-app notification AND sends push - full path traversal verified via logs (PUSH-PATH → SEND-PUSH → tokens found → Expo API called). The Expo API call returns error for test tokens which is expected. Key finding: the push flow is complete, any issues with like pushes in production would be due to missing device tokens for the post author, not code path issues.
